content:
Alex K: Flying into CPT for the offsite next week — any last-minute packing tips? worried about sun + wind + weird plugs. is a hoodie enough or should I bring a proper windbreaker?
Priya S: Definitely bring a windbreaker. mornings by the water are breezy even if it warms up midday. SPF 50 for sure.
Maya L: FYI South Africa uses Type M (3-round) sockets in a lot of places. I carried a tiny universal adapter + a small power strip and it saved me when the room had one outlet. :plug:
Tom R: Also bring insect repellent if we do the sunset boat thing, bites were bad for me last time. reusable water bottle + electrolytes for midday walks. :sunglasses:
Jordan: Poll — do we want a communal power strip in the Airbnb? React with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Priya S: :thumbsup: — hotels can be stingy with outlets.
Alex K: +1 for communal strip. who wants to coordinate buying one?
Maya L: I can bring a small 4-outlet strip and a Type M adapter.
Tom R: I will grab a travel-size insect repellent and some SPF lip balm.
Jordan: Also thinking about sun protection for hair/scalp — baseball cap + SPF mist?
travel-bot: Packing checklist for Cape Town offsite: https://redwood.internal/checklists/cape-town-offsite — includes adapters, meds, docs.
Alex K: Love the checklist link, thanks! quick packing snippet I keep:

```
Packing snippet:
- SPF 50 sunscreen
- light windbreaker + hoodie
- hat / baseball cap
- Type M universal adapter + small power strip
- insect repellent
- reusable water bottle + electrolyte tabs
- comfy walking shoes + sandals
- small daypack for hikes
```

Priya S: Also note: outlets in some venues are 3-pin but spaced weirdly; a short flat extension is nice so you don't block the whole desk.
Maya L: Pro tip — foldable sun umbrella for sudden wind/rain, and a packable dry bag for phone on boat trips.
Jordan: Vote check — :thumbsup: for communal strip = 4, :thumbsdown: = 0. communal strip wins.
Alex K: Gracias team — I'll bring the strip + adapters. see you in CPT! :airplane:
